title: The tutor is slow at 09:00 and some answers never arrive
area: ADK agents, FastAPI and Cloud Run
scenario: At the 09:00 cohort start the FastAPI tutor on Cloud Run takes 10-25 s and 6% of turns end in 504s. Gemini latency is unchanged, CPU is under 10% and only 2-3 of 20 instances run. L2 blames cold starts and wants min instances 5. You get the service.yaml, the code, request logs and metrics.
task: Find why one instance serves one turn at a time and prove it with make load
Explain why the autoscaler did not add instances and where the 504s come from
Rule cold starts in or out
Fix the handler and the Cloud Run concurrency and timeout
acceptance: Concurrent turns overlap; health checks answer during load
Root cause and evidence in ANSWER.md

practices.label: Week 4 Wed - Cloud Run concurrency, CPU allocation and timeouts
Week 4 Mon - FastAPI async vs sync handlers
